objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the server-side template injection weakness of a small Flask page that greets the visitor by name and read the flag in /tmp/flag.
hints: Find the input that ends up inside the template source rather than being passed to it as data.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets your input be evaluated by the template engine?

steps.title: Name the template engine
steps.prompt: Which template engine renders the greeting?
